title: Phoning about a summer job
instructionsHu: Egy balatoni fagylaltozó nyári diákmunkára keres valakit. Hívd fel az angol tulajdonost, mutatkozz be, mondd el, miért lennél jó a munkára, és tudd meg a részleteket. Minden pontot teljesíts.

situation.context: You have seen an advertisement for a summer job at an ice-cream shop in Siófok, at Lake Balaton. The owner is a British man who has lived in Hungary for some years but does not speak Hungarian well. You phone him to ask about the job.
situation.candidateRole: You are a student who would like to get the summer job.
situation.examinerRole: The examiner is Mr Harris, the owner of the ice-cream shop.
goals: Say why you are calling and why you are interested in the job.
Tell him about your experience and skills, for example languages or working with people.
Ask about the working hours and the pay.
Arrange a day when you can come in for a trial day.
situation.examinerOpening: Hello, Harris Ice Cream, Tom speaking.

followUpQuestions: Oh, great. Have you ever worked with customers before?
Well, it's quite hard work, especially at weekends. Is there anything you'd like to know about the job?
Could you come in for a trial day next week? Which day would suit you?

usefulPhrases.en: I'm calling about the summer job advertisement.
usefulPhrases.hu: A nyári munkáról szóló hirdetés miatt telefonálok.

usefulPhrases.en: I helped out at my uncle's café last year.
What would my working hours be?
How much is the pay per hour?
I'm looking forward to meeting you.

turns.speaker: examiner
turns.text: Hello, Harris Ice Cream, Tom speaking.

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: Hello, Mr Harris. My name is Eszter Varga, and I'm calling about the summer job you advertised. I'm very interested, because I enjoy working with people, and my family has a holiday home in Siófok.

turns.speaker: examiner
turns.text: Oh, great. Have you ever worked with customers before?

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: Yes, last summer I worked in a bakery in Veszprém for a month. I served customers and took payments. I also speak English and a little German, which could be useful with tourists.

turns.speaker: examiner
turns.text: Well, it's quite hard work, especially at weekends. Is there anything you'd like to know about the job?

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: Yes, what would my working hours be? And how much do you pay per hour?

turns.speaker: examiner
turns.text: It's six hours a day, five days a week, either from ten till four or from four till ten. We pay two thousand two hundred forints an hour, plus tips.

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: That sounds fine. I don't mind working in the evenings or at weekends.

turns.speaker: examiner
turns.text: Could you come in for a trial day next week? Which day would suit you?

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: Would Tuesday be OK? I could come in the morning and be there at about ten.

turns.speaker: examiner
turns.text: Tuesday at ten is perfect. The shop is on the promenade, near the pier.

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: Great, thank you. See you on Tuesday, Mr Harris. Goodbye!

notes: Kommunikációs cél: a vizsgázó elmondja, miért telefonál és miért érdekli a munka, bemutatja a tapasztalatát és a nyelvtudását, rákérdez a munkaidőre és a fizetésre, végül időpontot egyeztet a próbanapra – mind a négy szempont teljesül.
Szókincs: az álláskeresés fordulatai természetesek és a helyzethez illők (the summer job you advertised, served customers, took payments, per hour, trial day).

Nyelvhelyesség: a múltbeli tapasztalatot egyszerű múlt írja le (worked, served, took), a „which could be useful” mellékmondat helyes, az udvarias kérdések (What would my working hours be? Would Tuesday be OK?) szórendje is pontos.
Érdemes megtanulni: „I'm calling about the summer job you advertised”, „which could be useful with tourists”, „I don't mind working in the evenings”, „Would Tuesday be OK?”.
